name: request:new
description: An idea from a booth visitor or a user. Inbox; never picked up, body never edited.

name: bug:triage
description: An agent may reproduce it and write the triage report.

name: bug:needs-info
description: Could not reproduce. Waiting on the reporter.

name: bug:ready
description: Triage report accepted. An agent may fix it.

name: bug:blocked
description: Agent stopped on a blocker in its handoff. Maintainer re-adds the label it came from.

name: feature:spec
description: Business or technical spec in progress.

name: feature:ready
description: Business sections accepted and Technical spec written by a developer. Agents deliver it.

name: feature:planned
description: Split into tasks. Never picked up itself.

name: feature:blocked
description: Agent stopped on a blocker in its handoff. Maintainer re-adds the label it came from.

name: task:draft
description: Scope written; technical spec, approval, or deps missing.

name: task:blocked
description: Agent stopped on a blocker in its handoff. Maintainer re-adds the label it came from.

name: flaky-test
description: Names a test that fails without a code change. Delivery skips its base-commit check.

name: needs-simulator
description: PR parked: a Done when line needs a simulator run that has not happened.

name: needs-native-build
description: PR changes native code: cannot ship over the air. A maintainer merges it and ships a binary.
